title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.1.4 — Native Offline GPS Queue & Single Truth Location
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.1.4:
• Removed duplicate second message: unified location under native Android engine (accurate real device coordinates)
• Added native SharedPreferences offline queue: movements while offline are never lost and auto-flush the instant internet reconnects
• Clean notification: sleek 'Active & Guarding' status text
• Enhanced 10m background movement detection across GPS, Network, and Passive providers
